mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.type_id, g.confidence, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.timestamp, g.image_url, g.processed_image_url, g.create_time, gt.name as type_name, gt.description as type_description FROM garbage_data g LEFT JOIN garbage_types gt ON g.type_id = gt.id ORDER BY g.timestamp DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT g.id, g.type_id, g.confidence, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.timestamp, g.image_url, g.processed_image_url, g.create_time, gt.name as type_name, gt.description as type_description FROM garbage_data g LEFT JOIN garbage_types gt ON g.type_id = gt.id ORDER BY g.timestamp DESC

SELECT g.id, g.type_id, g.confidence, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.timestamp, g.image_url, g.processed_image_url, g.create_time, gt.name as type_name, gt.description as type_description FROM garbage_data g LEFT JOIN garbage_types gt ON g.type_id = gt.id WHERE g.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO garbage_data (type_id, confidence, latitude, longitude, timestamp, image_url, processed_image_url, create_time) VALUES (#{typeId}, #{confidence}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{timestamp}, #{imageUrl}, #{processedImageUrl}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE garbage_data SET type_id = #{typeId}, confidence = #{confidence}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, timestamp = #{timestamp}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, processed_image_url = #{processedImageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.type_id, g.confidence, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.timestamp, g.image_url, g.processed_image_url, g.create_time, gt.name as type_name, gt.description as type_description FROM garbage_data g LEFT JOIN garbage_types gt ON g.type_id = gt.id WHERE gt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY g.timestamp DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM garbage_data g LEFT JOIN garbage_types gt ON g.type_id = gt.id WHERE gt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
